facts.text: Under Randolph-Macon's Four-Year Degree Guarantee, the college waives tuition for courses to complete the degree if a student does not graduate in four years.

sources.title: Four-Year Degree Guarantee - Randolph-Macon College
sources.quote: if you don't graduate in four years, we'll waive tuition for courses to complete your degree.

facts.text: January term, known on campus as J-Term, is a 20-day mini-mester between the fall and spring semesters.

sources.title: January Term - Randolph-Macon College
sources.quote: Affectionately called “J-Term” on campus, January term is our 20-day mini-mester between fall and spring semester.
